svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Cut 180 long from 50.8 x 2.0 welded steel tube; square the ends

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Slot one end across a diameter: two slots 10.5 wide, 50 deep, top and bottom

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Mark the slots with a strip of paper round the tube so they line up

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Cut with a hacksaw or thin cutting disc; file to 10.5, square at the root

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Deburr the bore at the open end and break its edge 1 x 45 deg

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: The bore is 46.8: the 44.5 pole slides in with 1.15 clearance each side

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: The pole goes in 130 and stops against the end of the plate

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fits: the plate slides into both slots with no more than 0.5 total play

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: a 300 offcut of pole tube slides in and out by hand
